newsitem.title: UK: General Accident clarifies MGAM fund move.
newsitem.headline: General Accident clarifies MGAM fund move.

text.p: UK insurance group General Accident Plc said on Thursday its retirement from the trusteeship of two Morgan Grenfell Asset Management funds was not connected to possible irregularities at the funds.

"General Accident wishes to make it clear that it retired from the trusteeship of thse funds by mutual agreement with the fund managers and that its retirement was unrelated to any concerns regarding possible breaches by the funds," the insurer said in a statement.
"This is contrary to what has been suggested in some press reports," General Accident said.
General Accident said the decision to transfer the trusteeships to new trustees was taken in August 1995. The transition was completed on June 30 this year.

Trading in three European funds run by MGAM was suspended on Monday and resumed earlier today amid an investigation by MGAM and IMRO, the British investment funds watchdog, into suspected irregularities at the funds.
